name: n8n Gmail Readers
description: Consolidated card for the four Gmail reader workflows (main, brand, personal, business). Each skill maps to one OAuth-scoped account and is invoked via its dedicated webhook. Medium sensitivity because mailbox contents include customer threads and personal email.

skills.name: Gmail Read Main
skills.description: Reads recent messages from the primary CoreDirective mailbox.

skills.name: Gmail Read Brand
skills.description: Reads recent messages from the brand mailbox.

skills.name: Gmail Read Personal
skills.description: Reads recent messages from the personal mailbox.

skills.name: Gmail Read Business
skills.description: Reads recent messages from the business mailbox.
